peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 3.5% above its local comparables; 34 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (5.9): 2.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 3 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 58.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $960,000 ($1,982 psf, 484–624 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,915 psf (range $1,901–2,230); 3.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $32,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Dakota MRT about 180 m, Mountbatten MRT about 640 m; closer than 36 of 51 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 470 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 480 m), more than 28 of 51 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Old Airport Road Food Centre And Shopping Mall about 390 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 540 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Old Airport Road Food Centre And Shopping Mall

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 270 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 780 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 890 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 940 m; Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 1,010 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,030 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,150 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 1,210 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 374 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 459 new sales and 949 resales (1,408 purchases); new sales were 32.6% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,460 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 949 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 46 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 949 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,086 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−12.6%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
